Definition
[asymptotic volume ratio] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0342 1. ch16:16.14\group Heat Kernel Bounds

For a complete noncompact manifold with $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$, set \[ \operatorname {AVR}(g)=\lim _{r\to \infty } \frac{\operatorname {Vol}B(p,r)}{\omega _nr^n}. \]
